title: Understanding the Sampling Distribution
text: To plot the sampling distribution of the sample mean, consider what the sample mean represents in this context. What values can the sample mean take when drawing from the box?

title: Possible Values of the Sample Mean
text: Since you are drawing a sample of size $$3$$ with replacement, the sample mean can be calculated as the average of the values drawn. What are the possible values for the sample mean?

title: Calculating the Sample Mean
text: If you draw three tickets, each worth either $$0$$ or $$3$$ dollars, what are the possible combinations of ticket values? Calculate the sample mean for each combination.

title: Plotting the Distribution
text: Once you have the possible sample means, think about how to represent their probabilities on a plot. What should the axes represent?

hintAnswer: The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is probability.
title: Axes Titles for the Plot
text: For the plot of the sampling distribution of the sample mean, what should the horizontal and vertical axes represent?
choices: The horizontal axis is probability and the vertical axis is the sample mean.
The horizontal axis is the ticket value and the vertical axis is the count of tickets.
The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is probability.
The horizontal axis is the sample size and the vertical axis is the sample mean.
The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is the number of samples drawn.
